result.narrative:
Vardhit Auto Components Limited has one open overdue notification under TCI policy TCI-WT-2026-0002, the oldest item 36 days past due, against exposure of INR 26m on an INR 60m limit. The payment review calls the trend deteriorating: the last four resolved notifications all cleared within 3-6 days of due date over the preceding ~10 months, so the current item is materially longer than anything in the buyer's recent history. Notification frequency is not accelerating (2 in the last 6 months versus 3 prior) — it is the severity of this single item that has changed.

The band is driven entirely by payment. 36 DPD gives a payment raw of 42.0, weighted 0.65 x 42.0 = 27.3; the news component contributes 0.35 x 0.0, giving a score of 27.3 and a PD of 0.173 in the Watch band. The adjudicator agreed with caveats rather than agreeing outright, and the caveats matter here because this one notification carries the whole score: the record is dated 2026-10-18 while citing an original due date of 2026-10-18, which cannot also be 36 days past due, so the DPD should be confirmed against the source ledger before the verdict is relied on. The adjudicator also flags that the structured 'owed' field reports INR 26,000,000 while the narrative describes the sum actually past due as INR 7.0m against total exposure of INR 26m, that all notifications come from a single policy with a single insurer so there is no cross-carrier validation, and that the zero news score reflects a screen that returned no article and no evidence record at all — absence of evidence rather than a confirmed clean record.

The recommendation is MAINTAIN on the single TCI line: current limit INR 60,000,000, revised limit INR 60,000,000, change 0, on the grounds that PD of 0.173 is within the appetite target of 0.25. Expected loss is unchanged at INR 7,473,600 before and after. Given the adjudicator's caveats, the sensible approval is to maintain the limit while confirming the 36 DPD figure and the true past-due amount against the ledger, and obtaining a resolution date for the open item.

The score sits 7.3 points above the Healthy line at 20.0, so settlement of the open overdue and a return to the prior 3-6 day clearance pattern would move the buyer down a band. In the other direction, High Risk begins at 50.0, 22.7 points away, which the payment component alone would reach at 54 DPD — roughly another two and a half weeks of non-payment on the current item.

judgement.bottom_line: Maintain the INR 60,000,000 TCI limit (no change) — PD of 0.173 is within the 0.25 appetite target despite the Watch band. The adjudicator agreed with caveats: the sole scored notification is internally contradictory (dated 2026-10-18 citing an original due date of 2026-10-18 yet scored at 36 DPD) and the past-due amount is reported as both INR 7.0m and INR 26m, so confirm both against the ledger before releasing.
